description: This Java source file defines the `AcknowledgementForwarderActor` class, which is an Akka actor responsible for forwarding acknowledgements related to signals in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages acknowledgements, handles timeouts, and constructs actor names based on correlation IDs. The class includes methods to create actor instances with specific configurations, and features logic for starting or stopping actors based on incoming messages and timeouts.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActor
classes.description: An Akka actor designed to forward acknowledgement signals for a specific correlation ID. Handles message forwarding, timeouts, and actor name determination based on message headers. Provides static methods for creating actor properties and starting actors in the context.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method for creating Props configuration for a new AcknowledgementForwarderActor instance.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handlers for received messages, including forwarding acknowledgements and handling timeouts.

methods.name: forwardCommandResponse
methods.description: Forwards a received acknowledgement command response to the original requester actor.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events by logging and stopping the actor.

methods.name: determineActorName
methods.description: Constructs the actor name based on the correlation ID extracted from DittoHeaders, encoding it for URL safety.

methods.name: startAcknowledgementForwarderForTest
methods.description: Utility method to instantiate and start an acknowledgement forwarder actor for testing purposes.

methods.name: startAcknowledgementForwarder
methods.description: Creates and starts an acknowledgement forwarder actor with a name derived from the message headers, or reuses existing actors if available.
